mapper.insert: insert into theme_team_run_member(run_id,member_id,previous_session_id,session_id) select r.id,#{memberId},#{previousSessionId,jdbcType=BIGINT},n.id from theme_team_run r join topic_route_session n on n.id=#{sessionId} and n.member_id=#{memberId} and n.activity_id=r.activity_id and n.topic_id=r.topic_id and n.play_instance_id=r.play_instance_id left join topic_route_session p on p.id=#{previousSessionId,jdbcType=BIGINT} where r.id=#{runId} and r.play_instance_id is not null and (#{previousSessionId,jdbcType=BIGINT} is null or (p.member_id=#{memberId} and p.activity_id=r.activity_id and p.topic_id=r.topic_id))
